newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Antenna Hungaria sell-off not on agenda-Horn.
newsitem.headline: Antenna Hungaria sell-off not on agenda-Horn.

text.p: Hungary's prime minister Gyula Horn said on Tuesday the privatisation of broadcasting company Antenna Hungaria Rt, which transmits all of Hungary's national television and radio programmes, was not on the agenda.
"Privatising Antenna Hungaria is not on the government's agenda," Horn told reporters.
